caption:
A clean sheet for Tuesday

Monday's page was full and checked. Tuesday got a clean sheet of its own.

A new page for a new day takes two seconds, and yesterday's list stops following you around.

For whoever starts the day on a fresh page, not yesterday's.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a used paper page titled Mon with four ticked boxes. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and a clean page titled Tue slides in from the right and lands on top of the old one, with a small sparkle above it. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me: today gets a fresh page.
